page.title: OurTaiko · Let the love of taiko ring together
page.description: OurTaiko makes an open-source taiko game, a website for charts and players, and a chart editor: OurTaikoPlay, OurTaikoNet and OurTaikoEdit.
hero.lead: Let the love of taiko ring together.
hero.description: An open-source taiko game, a website for charts and players, and an editor to write charts.
products.label: Products
play.description: An open-source taiko rhythm game in the Nijiiro style. Play with a keyboard, mouse or touch — solo, two players, online rooms or dan courses.
net.tagline: Charts and players, in one place.
net.description: Fanmade charts, the official song list and player pages, together on one website.
edit.tagline: What you write is what you play.
edit.description: A taiko chart editor. Write TJA on the left, watch the lane and edit the timeline on the right, and play it any time.
edit.shotAlt: The OurTaikoEdit window: TJA code on the left, the lane preview at the top right and a timeline with three branches below it
more.title: More open source.
more.sub: The small parts behind the game, the website and the editor are open too.
more.parser: The TJA parser shared by the game, the website and the editor, so a chart reads the same everywhere.
more.view: A chart player in the browser, with autoplay, speed practice and jumping to a measure.
more.otanim: A light 2D animation format, .otanim, that brings companions to life in the game and on the website.
community.title: The next DON is yours.
community.description: We came together over taiko. Try the products, share your ideas, or build them with us.
